causeGlossary.Watercraft: Death caused by a collision with a boat hull or propeller.
causeGlossary.Flood Gate/Canal Lock: Death associated with a flood-control gate or canal lock.
causeGlossary.Human-Related, Other: Other human-related causes, such as entanglement or ingestion of debris.
causeGlossary.Perinatal: A dependent calf 150 cm or shorter that died at or near birth.
causeGlossary.Cold Stress: Death associated with cold-stress syndrome after prolonged cold exposure.
causeGlossary.Natural: Natural causes such as disease, injury, or brevetoxicosis.
causeGlossary.Undetermined: Too Decomposed: Cause could not be determined because of decomposition.
causeGlossary.Undetermined: Other: Cause could not be determined for another reason.
causeGlossary.Verified, Not Necropsied: The death was verified, but a full necropsy was not completed.
